description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class that sets up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) settings. It configures a permissive CORS policy for development purposes, allowing all origins and common HTTP methods to access the application's REST endpoints and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: WebMvcConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that provides a CORS configuration bean allowing cross-origin requests for development.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a WebMvcConfigurer bean that configures CORS mappings to allow all origins, common HTTP methods, and headers, with a max age for preflight requests.
